description: USB Drive Letter Manager - Windows service that controls drive letter assignment for USB drives.
notes: USBDLM runs as a Windows service. To register it, open an elevated shell in the app directory and run _service_register.cmd
Settings live in USBDLM.ini, which is persisted across updates. Run _edit-ini.cmd to edit it; USBDLM_sample.ini and USBDLM_sample_full.ini document the available options.
